If your pet needs emergency care near Portland, Oregon, I’d prioritize a **24/7 emergency veterinary hospital with an on-site emergency team** rather than waiting for a regular vet to open.

If your pet is struggling to breathe, collapsing, having seizures, bleeding heavily, or may have swallowed poison, call an emergency hospital immediately and start heading there once they advise you to come. Call ahead so the team can prepare.
